entry.title: Rewards and XP (serves Session 26 Achievements)
entry.learningObjective: Review earned XP, rank milestones, and achievement criteria tied to real completed actions.
entry.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package F: confirmed the flagged data-source gap was real — Rewards.jsx previously displayed only the local optimistic XP cache (session.xp), never independently reading the canonical server record. Fixed by fetching GET /api/smokecraft/player-state (fetchPlayerState(), the same canonical client already proven for the leaderboard) on mount/retry/after-claim and sourcing the displayed XP total + rank from it, with an honest local fallback (never presented as server-verified) when offline. Completion/XP/badge award path is unchanged — same completeSession()/smokecraft_session_completions ledger and awardSessionRewards() flow already proven idempotent and server-authoritative for every other session; no second reward/achievement system was created.
